facts.text: I am thinking of buying a new keyboard with more features and sounds than my current Yamaha P-125.
I have been looking at newer keyboard models from Korg and Roland.
I am thinking of spending around $500-$1000 on a new keyboard.
I mostly play piano and some synth sounds.
I want a keyboard with recording capabilities.
I want a keyboard with USB connectivity.
Portability is not a big deal for me.
I just started taking ukulele lessons with my friend Rachel today.
I have been struggling with fingerpicking because my fingers get tangled and it is hard to get a smooth sound.
Rachel has been giving me exercises to practice for fingerpicking.
I have been thinking about getting my Taylor GS Mini serviced.
The action on my Taylor GS Mini is high and it has been causing discomfort in my left hand.
I plan to take my Taylor GS Mini to a guitar tech named Joe who works at Guitar Central by the end of this month.
I am thinking about selling my harmonica, a Hohner Special 20.
I have not played the Hohner Special 20 in ages.
The Hohner Special 20 is collecting dust in my music room.
I am considering putting the Hohner Special 20 up on eBay.
